saved_measurement.units: MB/s decimal1000000B/s; added filler ranges in binary GiB, not total disk/filesystem/NAND occupancy
saved_measurement.perfile: All30 exact per-file medians/counts reproduce saved assessment; see summary.json#/perfile
saved_measurement.file29_incomplete: 52 measured read samples versus63 for each completed file. Each completed file also has an initial Calculating and final Complete phase3 record; these are excluded from measured-rate medians.
saved_measurement.wall_clock_phase_file_rates: Not recoverable exactly: journal stores no native timestamp or elapsed duration. Host snapshot UTC dates collection, and ETA/rolling rate cannot reconstruct per-phase/file duration. UI update count is not an elapsed timer.
saved_measurement.sampling_limits: Rates use recent <=30s windows, minimum3s and1MiB. Progress sampled at256MiB boundaries plus phase changes. Some adjacent windows overlap; overlap is not uniform. At the three write medians, nominal256MiB spacing is23.17s,26.95s,35.59s, and verified reads about18.1s. These remain descriptive estimates, not independent trials or confidence intervals.

operation_audit.observed_static_behavior: Single-threaded caller; one synchronous syscall803 write of1MiB followed by hash/accounting and syscall840 query before next iteration. No async submission or multiple outstanding requests at this application layer.
operation_audit.cost_model: Call count and request size constant perMiB; underlying latency can vary with allocation/cache/media/driver work.
operation_audit.unknown: Synchronous application depth1 does not prove LV2/LV1/controller hardware queue depth, cache policy, request splitting or NCQ absence.

operation_audit.observed_static_behavior: Two calls to the SAME syscall840 per1MiB, before and after write; an extra call after each new file open. Both return total/available and validate raw baseline/reserve, headroom and unexpectedly large available-byte decrease.
operation_audit.snapshot_work_count: 491520MiB written =>983040 mandatory loop space queries plus30 postopen extra queries, excluding initial baseline query.
operation_audit.cost_model: Guard scalar comparisons constant; syscall implementation cost not timed. Allocation/free-space complexity could be occupancy-sensitive only if the exact implementation demonstrates or measurement isolates it.
operation_audit.safety: Keep128GiB available reserve plus2GiB metadata and next1MiB headroom; no query removal or reduced reserve is released. Unused older main.c RESERVE64GiB macro does not override active RESERVE_BB128GiB.

operation_audit.observed_static_behavior: Write generates each1MiB with fixed integer mixing per8B, then hashes returned bytes. Verification regenerates a separate1MiB wanted buffer, compares full valid bytes, then hashes read bytes. SHA copies input byte-by-byte into64B streaming blocks and compresses64 rounds.
operation_audit.cost_model: Fixed source work per byte, independent of occupancy; index/offset values change but loop lengths do not. Actual PPU wall/CPU time, thermal/frequency effects and lower-layer crypto are unmeasured.
operation_audit.implication: Read+pattern+comparison+SHA at14.84MB/s can form a processing ceiling; neither that ceiling nor raw SSD read speed is established without component timing. CPU-only diagnostic improvement may have no game/save/install benefit.

operation_audit.observed_static_behavior: Each write1MiB begins poll_stop: controller/callback handling then token lookup under/dev_usb000; an absent STOP causes an open syscall returning ENOENT. Verification checks USB STOP per16MiB, with additional controller polling per1MiB via ui_tick. Present token requires exact64B +EOF +close and exact session marker.
operation_audit.cost_model: Fixed lookup frequency per byte; USB/FS lookup latency may vary and is unmeasured. Controller work is performed before UI redraw throttle, even when no redraw occurs.
operation_audit.safety: Retain Circle/STOP handling, exact marker validation and error behavior. Blocking syscalls have no guaranteed cancellation wall-clock bound.

operation_audit.observed_static_behavior: Nonforced redraw throttled to >=250ms, forced at each progress publication; timebase sampled from mftb using syscall147 frequency initialized once. Full CPU framebuffer clear/text render, ordering barriers, flip submission and callback work. Pending flip wait loops sleep1ms up to3000 iterations.
operation_audit.cost_model: Roughly time-based4Hz work plus forced redraws; more time perMiB means potentially more redraws perMiB. Frame size depends on display resolution640..1920 by480..1080, not volume occupancy; resolution and flip time are not stored in progress journal.
operation_audit.memory: Two128B-aligned1MiB storage/pattern buffers plus32MiB app GCM I/O allocation; GPU framebuffers separate. Storage buffer declarations do not prove4KiB pointer alignment or physical extent alignment.
operation_audit.safety: Potential redraw/controller duplicate optimization must retain live cancellation and truthful operation progress; no frozen source changed.

operation_audit.observed_static_behavior: At256MiB payload boundaries and phase transitions, force UI update, encode256B record, SHA224B, USB write256B and fsync. sequence capped16384; all errors/shortwrites stop.
operation_audit.cost_model: Publication frequency per byte fixed; USB journal growth/allocation/fsync behavior may vary, but no duration is recorded. Constant source work does not prove constant native call latency.
operation_audit.limit: Rate snapshot is calculated before that record's USB write/fsync; later ETA windows can include earlier publication cost. Final file-write fsync happens after last phase2 progress record, so file completion latency is incompletely represented by rolling write samples.
operation_audit.safety: Do not omit progress synchronization merely for speed; any changed journal batching needs separate review of observability/cancellation/recovery semantics.

operation_audit.component: HDD file sync / close / integrity lifecycle
operation_audit.observed_static_behavior: Each completed write file gets syscall820 fsync and close before phase3 full pattern/SHA/size/EOF readback. Later phase4 rereads all retained files, followed by16 game controls. fsync/close errors recorded and success bits withheld; read-close errors propagate. On partial write, returned bytes are hashed/accounted before error stop; partial files retained.
operation_audit.cost_model: Per-file sync may vary with dirty data/durability implementation/media latency; timing unavailable. Syscall820 success does not prove ATA FLUSH opcode, FUA use or power-loss durability.
operation_audit.receipt: USB result write/fsync/close, exact8192B reread/compare, then DONE token write/fsync/close. A matching final receipt remains a separate gate; this historical log is unfinished.
operation_audit.safety: Preserve sync/close error cleanup, no deletion/auto-resume and full integrity lifecycle. Higher diagnostic speed cannot substitute for capacity/persistence/game/placement qualification.

operation_audit.observed_static_behavior: 1MiB requested write/read sizes and sequential offsets are4KiB multiples. Buffer pointers are guaranteed128B alignment by source, not4KiB. Read verification uses a second1MiB regenerated-pattern buffer and software SHA input copies.
operation_audit.cost_model: Application copying is fixed per byte; filesystem extents, crypto-sector mapping, kernel bounce buffers and SSD internal page/erase size unknown from this source.
operation_audit.limit: No claim of4KiB physical alignment, read-modify-write amplification or NAND page size follows from512B advertised sectors or these application buffer declarations.

write_slowdown_equivalent_cost.interpretation: Only a magnitude target for timer design. Reciprocal median arithmetic is not a mean duration, measured overhead, causal decomposition or expected optimization gain. Distinct windows/source phases and sampling make the single-component scenarios especially hypothetical.

bottleneck_findings.write: A34.9156% measured guarded-write median reduction is reproduced. Same fixed1MiB application loop and source workload at all stages. Occupancy/time-dependent filesystem or SSD work, variable guard/USB/UI latency or combinations remain candidates; no cause isolated.
bottleneck_findings.read: Verified-read medians change0.0700%. Full software verification adds CPU/copy/render overhead, so underlying read degradation could remain below that processing ceiling. No syscall-only read limit measured.
bottleneck_findings.counterevidence: Simple claim that both read and write become proportionally slower is contradicted at the measured application level. A purely fixed-cost per-byte algorithm cannot alone explain a new step unless its native timing or time-based work changes. Flat verified reads weaken broad explanations affecting all components equally but do not eliminate write-specific allocation/media or CPU-capped reads.

proposed_component_timers.status: Design only; no native helper built/released/executed
proposed_component_timers.clock: App-owned monotonic mftb converted with measured timebase frequency as frozen UI already does. Record native monotonic_us at phase/file boundaries and each timed interval. Wall-clock UTC belongs in host manifest, not rate calculation. Check monotonicity/wrap/overflow.
proposed_component_timers.calibration: Before I/O, measure back-to-back timestamp reads and an empty instrumented block over>=10000 iterations; publish p50/p95/p99/max and raw timer overhead. Require instrumentation overhead<1% of smallest relevant median interval, otherwise batch timing or use lower-overhead ticks. Keep raw and overhead-bounded estimates; do not blindly subtract or treat wall elapsed as CPU cycles.
components: read syscall802 elapsed plus requested/returned bytes and rc
write syscall803 elapsed plus requested/returned bytes and rc, only in later separately released fresh-file protocol
each syscall840 before/after/postopen individually, with returned total/available
open/fstat/EOF-read/file-fsync820/close individually; distinguish HDD from USB
pattern generation, SHA update/finalization and comparison individually
controller/callback polling separate from absent/present USB STOP open/read/EOF/close
UI timebase/ETA update, framebuffer rendering, flip wait/submission and callbacks separately
whole loop and file/phase boundaries including guard/UI/USB/sync; residual=whole minus exclusive accounted components
proposed_component_timers.crypto: No external kernel/RAM probe. User syscall time includes hidden filesystem/driver/crypto/media latency. Isolate lower-layer crypto only if exact static implementation plus later independently authorized app-owned instrumentation makes it observable; otherwise retain unknown.
proposed_component_timers.accounting: Use exclusive elapsed scopes to avoid ui_tick nested inside poll_stop/publish double counting. Keep counts, bytes, sum/min/max and log-binned or fixed-width latency distributions; p50/p95/p99/max and stall/error counts. Fixed in-memory bounded telemetry ring/histograms; export outside primary timed region and time export separately. Record dropped samples and instrumentation memory limit.
proposed_component_timers.controls: Freeze binary/hash, compiler options, buffer sizes/pointer alignment, request sizes, serial depth1 baseline, display mode/UI cadence, native file/phase and requested/actual bytes. Same retained ranges, pseudo-random seed and alternating paired order for syscall-only versus verified-read comparisons. Distinguish first/warm reads; no claim of cold cache without approved cache-control evidence. No cache/queue/power/TRIM settings changed.
proposed_component_timers.statistical_unit: Repeated independently bounded passes, not thousands of correlated rolling journal records. Publish paired whole-pass ratios and latency tails separately; do not derive confidence intervals by treating BF progress samples as independent.
proposed_component_timers.first_gate: Wait for owner-qualified current BF completion and fresh reviewed read-only protocol. Begin retained-file syscall-only versus verified-read comparisons with fixed bounded ranges; no deletion, new filler, resume/restart or write tests implied.
